title: Friends

[00:49.50]Friends

[00:56.91]Just to feel

[01:06.70]To be friends
[01:11.47]And I hope
[01:13.72]You like me too
[01:17.64]The same way that I do
[01:22.64]That I do
[01:29.34]And time
[01:30.82]Never felt so good

[01:40.45]With you
[02:23.09]And I hope
[02:24.93]You like me too
[02:29.30]The same way that I do
